subject: c6k pipeline pack built: 142 AIR + 129 Mali, 20.6MB (zlib v2); emitter loss fixed; Mali draw-variant logging+replay; auto-pack in package_metal_addon
body: c6k REC logs: all chunks arrived (0 incomplete) but the USB console cuts every line at ~256 bytes incl '|proc| ' prefix, so each 200-char chunk lost 5-7 chars (all 130+118 records damaged) and consecutive writes were glued on one physical line. Parser now splits glued lines; repair_records rebuilds each record from exact positions + logged key prefix: ui350 123/130 repaired (7 unrecoverable: 5 chunks with foreign text glued in, 2 other), ui654 116/118. Emitter fixed: 120-char chunks (line <= ~200). PSO_MISS console lines were capped at 96/process (so 98 lines hid 130 AIR misses): cap now 256; REC cap 640/process (no record dropped in c6k). Corpus gpu/build/pipeline-corpus/corpus.txt: 142 distinct AIR descriptions (c6k + c6jb). Replay with c6k tree (64909e5) + c6k frontend_defines + c6k profile extracted from the Mach-O: 142/142 predicted AIR keys produced, 129 Mali. Coverage vs c6k logs (pack key match): ui350 AIR 37/38, Mali 36/60, pack serves 73/98 miss lines = 26.6 of 34.6 s (77%); ui654 AIR 13/13, Mali 12/24, 25/37 lines = 13.9 of 18.9 s (74%). Remaining Mali = draw-time generic variants (specialization tables from the bound resources, not derivable from the descriptor): NEW this patch: emitter logs them (TPC_MISS v1 mali: vsha/fsha, vc/fc/opt tables, msgcap) on miss and hit, scan stores them in the corpus, replay compiles them against the SPIR-V of the replayed pipelines (self-test: 40 mali records re-derived from a replay -> byte-identical pack). Needs one device boot of the next build to harvest. Pack: gpu/build/pipeline-pack-20261026/c6k/PipelinePack.tpcpack 20,611,096 B (raw 71,464,009; compression v2 = per-entry zlib via libz dlsym, codec in the index flags word, reader in pipeline_cache.c, tests pass; worth it: 3.5x, 71MB -> 20.6MB). NEXT BUILD ID: not c6k's: compilers scope hashes pipeline_cache_frontend.inc + pipeline_cache.c/.h (all edited now) + both archives + headers, so it changes this time; later render-only edits keep it. Predicted from the current tree+archives: nord2-arch9-aa4073aca7b2... (tentative; the pack tool reads the real id from the linked bundle). WIRING: package_metal_addon.py now builds+ships a pack automatically from gpu/build/pipeline-corpus/corpus.txt (replay under the bundle id; --no-auto-pack / --pipeline-pack FILE); workflow after each device boot: pipeline_corpus.py scan LOG --bundle <bundle of that boot> (merges into the corpus). build_pipeline_pack takes --defines (default $NORD2_FRONTEND_DEFINES) because TEGU_INERT_PIPELINES etc. select compile paths. IMPORTANT: set NORD2_FRONTEND_DEFINES when packaging variants. Files edited (mine): metal/tegu/{pipeline_cache_frontend.inc,pipeline_cache.c,pipeline_cache.h,make_pipeline_pack.py,pipeline_corpus.py,pipeline_replay_host_test.inc}, tools/{build_pipeline_pack.py,build_pipeline_replay.py,package_metal_addon.py,pipeline_cache_report.py}, tests/{pipeline_keys_test.py,pipeline_pack_tool_test.py}, metal/README.nord2.md. Tests PASS: pipeline_keys_test, pipeline_pack_tool_test (incl. zlib/raw), pipeline_cache_host_test (asan). arm64 -Werror syntax of compute_frontend.m plain OK; with -DTEGU_RENDER_TRACE it fails on someone else's unused perfJob (compute_frontend.m:1978). Not committed by me.
